s: 辨識句意：根據聽到的內容，選出符合描述的圖片或符合圖片的描述
e:
Joseph　在等公車時看書，答案選(Ａ)。
錄音稿：Joseph is reading a book when waiting for the bus.

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
老師進教室之後看到學生在打架，答案選(Ｂ)。
錄音稿：After the teacher entered the classroom, he saw two students fighting with each other.

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
老人覺得電視節目有趣，但是小女孩不覺得，答案選(Ｂ)。
錄音稿：The old man finds the TV program interesting, but the little girl doesn’t look like she does.

s: 基本問答：根據聽到的內容，選出一個最適合的回應或最適合的問句
e:
目前不方便說話並要求晚點再回電，要回答「沒問題」，答案選(Ｃ)。
錄音稿：I can’t talk right now. Can I call you back?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: I got it from my grandparents.
e:
問　Lindy　的名字怎麼拼，正確的回答應是要把名字拼出來，答案選(Ｂ)。
錄音稿：How do you spell your name, Lindy?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: Sorry, I need it right now.
e:
詢問可否使用電腦，答者回答抱歉，他目前還需要用到電腦，答案選(Ａ)。
錄音稿：Excuse me, could I use your computer?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: The taxi driver will be late.
e:
在趕時間且要遲到了，而計程車正在等。應回答再給我五分鐘，答案選(Ａ)。
錄音稿：Hurry up! We’re late. The taxi is waiting.

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: I can’t believe you got the job!
e:
說話者不敢置信自己贏得了兩張臺北到倫敦的機票，答者應回覆「你真的很幸運！」，答案選(Ｃ)。
錄音稿：I can’t believe it. I won two plane tickets from Taipei to London.

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: I’ll be out in a minute.
e:
說話者表達自己需要使用廁所，對方已經待在裡面好幾小時了。答者應回答「再一分鐘就出來了。」，答案選(Ａ)。
錄音稿：Jack, I need to use the bathroom. You’ve been in there for hours.

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
詢問是否星期六能一起去逛街。答者回覆想要但是必須去學校，因此問者應該表示「很可惜。」，答案選(Ｃ)。
錄音稿：A: Can you go shopping with us on Saturday?
B: I’d love to, but I have to go to school.

s: 言談理解：根據聽到的內容，選出一個最適合的答案
e:
醫生不要男子喝咖啡和茶，故選(Ｂ)水。
錄音稿：W: Which one do you like, tea, coffee or water?
M: Water, please. My doctor does not want me to drink coffee and tea.
Q: What does the man want?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
爸爸提到，女兒已經有三雙鞋，故可推出　Rockets　應為鞋子的種類，故選(Ａ)。
錄音稿：G: Dad, I want to buy a pair of Rockets.
M: Don’t you already have three pairs of shoes?
G: Yes, but Rockets are different. All the sports stars wear them.
Q: What are Rockets?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: The skirt will be on sale next week.
The skirt is too expensive for her to buy.
The skirt is too long for her.
e:
男生提到女生一個月只賺一萬元，可推知此裙子對她太貴了，故選(Ｂ)。
錄音稿：W: Oh, look at this special yellow skirt. Just three thousand dollars.
M: It’ll cost you an arm and a leg. You only make ten thousand dollars a month.
Q: When the man tells the woman, “It’ll cost you an arm and a leg.” What does it mean?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
因為女生不想要等五天，店員告訴她可以選另一本相同價位的書，故選(Ｂ)。
錄音稿：W: Excuse me, sir. I bought this book yesterday, and found one page missing. Can I have a new one?
M: Let me see. I am sorry. This book’s been sold out. But I can order you a new one if you don’t mind waiting for five days.
W: Oh, that’s a long time.
M: Or you can choose another book at the same price.
W: OK. I think I’ll do that.
Q: What is the woman going to do?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
女生的第一句話即提到想要郵寄包裹，可推知他們人在郵局，故選(Ｃ)。
錄音稿：M: May I help you?
W: Yes, I’d like to mail this package to Hong Kong. How much should I pay?
M: Let me check. Could you write down your name and phone number, please?
W: Sure.
M: What’s inside the package?
W: Clothes and hats.
Q: Where are the man and the woman?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: A museum that collects old things.
A supermarket that sells cheaper things.
A shop that sells old things.
e:
根據敘述可知這家商店賣很多古老的二手商品，故選(Ｃ)。
錄音稿：W: Walter’s House is now open on Hope Street. When you shop at Walter’s House, you can find everything you need at low low prices. Many of the old things in the store look like new. We have beautiful clothes, special toys, useful tools, and interesting books and CDs. You won’t think they were used before. Why spend lots of money buying new things? Start by today, and you will find how wonderful old things are.
Q: What is Walter’s House?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
女生抱怨自從購物中心開幕後，家裡附近不太安靜，每天車子和人都很多，小孩還要求去那兒吃東西和買東西，故選(Ａ)。
錄音稿：W: Ever since the shopping center opened here, our town has not been as quiet as before. Hundreds of people and cars coming every day. The traffic is terrible.
M: Yeah, but it’s easier for us to buy things, isn’t it?
W: I know the shopping center is convenient, but now my kids often ask me to take them there to buy things or have some food.
Q: What does the woman think about the shopping center?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: He got lost in the train station.
He got off at the wrong station.
e:
由對話可知，男生應該是要往南，而火車開往北。故選(Ｃ)。
錄音稿：M: Excuse me, is this train going to Patan?
W: I am afraid we are going north.
M: Oh no! I should go south. I need to be in Patan by eleven. What’s the next station I need to get off?
W: We are getting close to Aven. You can get off there.
M: Thanks.
Q: What happened to the man?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
o: She may have to stay home.
e:
由對話內容，她拒絕男生的每個邀約，並且回答一整年都沒空，可推知選(Ｂ)。
錄音稿：W: Hello.
M: Hey, Jenny. Do you want to go see a movie today?
W: I don’t think I can. I need to clean the house.
M: Then, can we go tomorrow?
W: Well, I have to go to a dance class.
M: How about the day after tomorrow?
W: I am afraid I am going to be busy all year.
Q: Why DOESN’T the woman go to see a movie with the man?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
她們本來約十一點，但店面要等十二點才開門，Jenny　希望約晚一點，故選(Ｃ)。
錄音稿：W: Hello, this is Jenny. I just remember the shop we are going to won’t open until twelve tomorrow. If we meet up at eleven, we have to wait for an hour. Can we meet up later? Please call me back before ten.
Q: What time may Jenny want to meet up with her friend?

s: （請聽音檔，選出最適合的答案）
e:
I Still Believe　這禮拜一才新發行就登上排行榜第三名，故選(Ａ)。
錄音稿：It’s time for the top three songs on the music list this week. Number three is I Still Believe. It just came out this Monday, and has already hit number three this week. Number two is Listen to Your Heart. It dropped one place after staying on top for three weeks. Finally, climbing from number five, Slow Dance becomes our number one. Now we’re going to play our number one song.
Q: Which song is new on the music list this week?
